attributes.action: Petition to ban international breaks during the premier league season
attributes.additional_details: International breaks are boring and inconvenient and many players get injured for their country and can be out for I season this is why I and others believe they should be banned
attributes.background: Ban international breaks during the premier league season

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the UK Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about match schedules are a matter for the footballing authorities, not the UK Government or Parliament.
